blurb: We all remember getting teddy bears as kids, but how much do you know about stuffed bears? Learn about the fascinating history behind a classic childhood toy at The Den of Marbletown. We're a family owned and operated teddy bear museum in Kingston, Ulster County, Hudson Valley, NY. We also feature a café, and we sell fun gifts for the whole family at our gift shop.
